name: models-datasets
title: Trajectory Tracking Agent: task results (solution × split × task)
source: tools/build_dropins.py from solutions/<id>/scorecard.json and scorecard_holdout.json (each task row's objective, kpis, diagnostics, verdicts) and meta.json (tags, parent, change); links from site/data/runs/index.json; the shape is data-ui 74be0c9a gallery/examples/models-datasets-tta/

fields.name: family
fields.title: Family
fields.description: the solution's pN root (its change's first words); 'Ablations' for an ablation

fields.name: model
fields.title: Model
fields.description: the solution id's first segment (an ablation: its kind)

fields.name: config
fields.title: Config
fields.description: the rest of the solution id ('as built' when there is none)

fields.name: ablation
fields.title: Ablation
fields.description: tagged 'ablation' in meta.json: never ranked, never in the default view

fields.name: admissible
fields.title: Admissible (every gate, every task)
fields.description: the scorecard's verdict: every gate on every task

fields.name: deployment
fields.title: Deployment · split
fields.description: the scorecard's deployment and split: dev and holdout are never pooled

fields.name: dataset
fields.title: Dataset
fields.description: the dataset (its cell is the median of its tasks: the ruler's objective)

fields.name: rms_mm
fields.title: Tool tracking RMS
fields.description: RMS tool-point error over the task's moving samples (the task's objective)

fields.name: stop_mm
fields.title: Stop error
fields.description: the largest error at a stop (gate: at most 1 mm)

fields.name: gates
fields.title: Gates passed (of 5)
fields.description: of the 5 ruler gates on the task

fields.name: preview
fields.description: the task's target tool path, top and side

fields.name: opens
fields.title: Opens
fields.description: what a click on this task result's cell opens

fields.name: url
fields.title: Link
fields.description: the cell's link, relative to this file
